translations.translatedText: # Saturday 23.4.2022 (radio)
Young people in traffic. Flu season. Summer cottage sales. Digital services act. Cheerleading World Championships. The weather.
## Young people in traffic

![A young person does a wheelie on a moped in a car park.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5434,h_3057,x_0,y_442/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-81346460b4c084b5f84/1724310602)
Open image viewer
A young driver does a wheelie on a moped in a car park. Photo: Mikko Savolainen / Yle
The police are worried about young people's traffic accidents.
In Finland, more young people die in traffic accidents than in the other Nordic countries. Young people's crashes often involve high speed and drunk driving.
The police are now trying to reduce young people's traffic accidents. The police are increasing traffic checks in the evenings and at weekends, when young people's accidents usually happen.
The police plan to pay special attention to mopeds. The police plan to monitor young people's group rides, for example with drones.
## EU digital services act

![The European Parliament chamber, with a Google logo on a phone screen in front of it.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4877,h_2743,x_15,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-83814761090b0e59b5d/1627982867)
Open image viewer
The EU wants to remove hate speech and fake news from the internet. Photo: EPA / PATRICK SEEGER
The EU has agreed on a new digital services act.
The new law aims to stop hate speech and the spreading of false information online. If Facebook or YouTube do not remove false information, they could have to pay big fines.
The EU wants to tackle fake news, because Russia, for example, is now spreading a lot of war propaganda online.
## Influenza
![A woman blows her nose into a handkerchief.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11212199)
Open image viewer
The number of flu cases in Finland has started to rise. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Many people have now caught the flu.
The flu season usually starts at the end of the year, and in spring the number of illnesses goes down.
You can get the flu now even if you had a vaccine against it in the autumn. The effect of the vaccines may have already faded.
## Cottage sales
![A summer cottage by the water.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5243,h_2949,x_0,y_180/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7768966033378376cac/1613969450)
Open image viewer
The corona epidemic boosted cottage sales. Photo: Alamy / All Over Press
Fewer summer cottages have been sold this year than last year.
The National Land Survey says that about 250 waterfront cottages have been sold so far this year. That is 30 percent fewer than at the same time last year.
However, estate agents believe that cottage sales will pick up as summer approaches.

The corona time increased sales of summer cottages. Last year, about 3,800 cottages were sold in total, and the year before, just over 4,000. In 2019, before corona, fewer than 3,000 cottages were sold.
## Cheerleading
![Finnish women's cheerleading team](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3000,h_1688,x_0,y_113/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-94520362636fff449dd/1650683928)
Open image viewer
The Finnish women's cheerleading team. Photo: Tero Wester / Finnish Cheerleading Association
Finland has won gold in the women's cheerleading World Championships.
The host country, the USA, won silver, and Germany won bronze.
This was the 4th time in a row that Finland became the cheerleading world champion.
Finland also did well in the mixed category at the World Championships. The mixed team won bronze. The mixed team has both men and women in it.
## Sunday's weather
![Weather map of Finland](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12415321)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
On Sunday the weather will be dry and, in many areas, sunny too.
The daytime temperature is between 6 and 12 degrees. In northern Lapland it is cooler in places.
